channel.title: bytevikas Blog
channel.description: Android engineering articles by Vikas Dhiman: performance, architecture, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, Media3, and AI-assisted development.

item.title: Google Play Expanded Channels: Merchandising and Optimization, Exclusion Groups and Billing Lab Previews
item.description: Google Play now surfaces your catalog outside the app: featured products, cart abandonment reminders, checkout recommendations, Play Billing on web stores and Gemini pilots. How Merchandising and optimization works, which guardrails are still early access, and what to fix in purchase handling.

item.title: CameraX 1.7.0 Stable: Camera2Interop V2 Without Opt-In, Kotlin DSL Builders and What Else Shipped
item.description: CameraX 1.7.0 went stable on Nov 18, 2026. Camera2Interop V2 drops the experimental opt-in, new Kotlin DSL builders (preview, imageCapture, sessionConfig), deprecated V1 classes, and the stable feature set: viewfinder gestures, QHD, GPU ImageAnalysis, physical cameras.

item.title: Room 3.1 Alpha: Per-DAO Return Type Converters, Prepared Statement Cache and allowDataLossOnRecovery
item.description: Room 3.1.0-alpha01 to alpha04 (Sep to Nov 18, 2026): property-centric annotations, setConnectionPoolTimeout, setPreparedStatementCacheSize, allowDataLossOnRecovery(), built-in kotlin.uuid.Uuid converter, and @DaoReturnTypeConverters on individual DAO functions with query arguments. What to try, and what to hold back for production.

item.title: Android Developer Verification Goes Global in January 2027: Developer ID Status API, Console API and What to Do in CI
item.description: Android developer verification expands globally from January 2027 with seven distributors. What changed since the Sep 30 launch in four countries, limited distribution accounts at 50 devices, and how to automate package registration checks in CI with the Developer ID Status API and Developer Console API.

item.title: Compose 1.13.0 Stable and 1.14.0-alpha01: What Actually Changed, What Breaks, and What to Adopt First
item.description: Compose 1.13.0 went stable on Nov 18, 2026 alongside Material3 1.5.0 and 1.14.0-alpha01. The cumulative breaking changes since 1.12, the TextFieldState migration, Modifier.border and LazyLayoutCacheWindow changes, and what the first 1.14 alpha adds: lighting modifiers, BorderRenderer, DrawAnnotation.

item.title: Google Play Makes Adaptive Quality Mandatory: Foldable Screenshots and Tier 3 Requirements from April 2027
item.description: Google Play will require apps to meet Tier 3 adaptive quality and ship foldable screenshots from April 2027, with games following in August 2027 and API 37 targeting in August 2027. What each tier means, the screenshot formats, and how to prepare in Compose.

item.title: Consumer Keep Rules for Library Authors: Unblocking R8 and DEX Code Optimization in Your SDK
item.description: Google Play now measures DEX code optimization, and the keep rules your library bundles count against every app that ships it. Narrow rules, codegen over reflection, conditional rules for adapters, and why keepnames is not needed to read stack traces.

item.title: Compose Runtime 1.13.0-rc01: Read-Only computedStateOf, NaN Skipping Fix and the State Leak Fixes Worth Knowing
item.description: Compose Runtime 1.13.0-rc01 (Nov 4, 2026) needs Kotlin 2.2, makes the computedStateOf block read-only, fixes recomposition skipping for NaN and Dp.Unspecified, and closes ComputedState and movableContent leaks. What to check before upgrading.

item.title: Sign in with Google for Unity: The Open-Source Credential Manager Plugin, Setup Gotchas and Backend Token Handling
item.description: Google open-sourced a Sign in with Google plugin for Unity (Nov 10, 2026): Credential Manager on Android, GIDSignIn on iOS, an idToken event API, plus the Kotlin, API 34 and no-scopes gotchas to know before adopting it.

item.title: Compose Material3 1.5.0-rc01: The alpha26 to RC Migration Checklist for Sliders, TimePicker, Menus and Toggle Buttons
item.description: Material3 1.5.0-rc01 (Nov 4, 2026) is bug fixes only, which makes it the freeze point. A checklist of every source-breaking change since alpha25: Slider and RangeSlider state, Vibrant TimePicker renames, ExposedDropdownMenu import, ToggleButton, carousel and SearchBar scroll APIs.

item.title: CameraX 1.7.0-rc01 and rc02: Physical Camera Binding, Camera2Interop Abstract Classes and the Leak and Crash Fixes
item.description: CameraX 1.7.0-rc01 (Oct 21, 2026) and rc02 (Nov 4, 2026): bind use cases to physical cameras, Camera2Interop interfaces become abstract classes, Low Light Boost and Torch follow last-setting-wins, plus fixes for SurfaceTexture crashes, ImageAnalysis and VideoCapture leaks.

item.title: Media3 1.12.0-beta01: JSpecify Nullability, minSdk 24, CodecDB and the Removed APIs to Fix Before You Upgrade
item.description: Media3 1.12.0-beta01 (Nov 11, 2026): JSpecify replaces NullableType and UnknownNull, Gradle minSdk rises to 24, CodecDB recommends encoder settings, a subtitles slot lands in the Compose Player, and a list of removed deprecated symbols with their replacements.

item.title: SmileID and CameraX: ResolutionSelector, Backpressure and 18,000+ Device Types for On-Device Liveness
item.description: How SmileID moved its identity-verification SDKs to CameraX (Android Developers Blog, Nov 11, 2026): Preview plus ImageAnalysis, ResolutionSelector with a fallback rule, STRATEGY_KEEP_ONLY_LATEST, built-in device quirks, and the CameraX Skill.

item.title: Navigation3 1.2.1 and 1.3.0-alpha04: the compileSdk Fix, SceneInfo Title and URL, and a Shared-Entry Bug Fix
item.description: Navigation3 1.2.1 (Nov 4, 2026) drops compileSdk from 37 to 36; the 1.3 alphas add SceneInfo title and url from TitleMetadataKey/UrlMetadataKey and fix shared NavEntry rendering on pop-then-push.

item.title: AndroidX Web 1.0.0-alpha01: WebContent, WebContentView and the webkit 1.19 Navigation Changes
item.description: AndroidX Web 1.0.0-alpha01 (Nov 4, 2026): WebContent holds web engine session state that outlives Activities, plus WebContentView and DetachedWebContentView. WebKit 1.19.0-alpha01 adds NavigationState/PageState, captureState and an Executor startUpWebView overload.

item.title: Biometric 1.4.0-beta01: The Activity-Result API, Compose Launcher and Multiple Fallbacks
item.description: AndroidX Biometric 1.4.0-beta01 (Nov 4, 2026): registerForAuthenticationResult(), the biometric-compose launcher, up to four custom fallback options on Android 36.1, KeyAgreement CryptoObject, minSdk 23.

item.title: Compose at Android Dev Summit 2026: The Performance Skill as a Code-Review Checklist
item.description: Dev Summit Compose round-up: Compose 1.13 Grid and FlexBox, rewritten BasicTextField, AppState and Navigation 3 deep links, plus the new Compose performance Android skill turned into a seven-category code-review checklist with Kotlin examples.

item.title: Android XR Goes Production: XREAL AURA, Stable Jetpack XR, Geospatial APIs and the Engine Hub
item.description: XREAL AURA wired glasses launch with stable Jetpack SceneCore, ARCore and XR Runtime, stable Geospatial APIs, the Android XR Engine Hub for Unity, Godot and Unreal, and ML Kit Text to Speech for audio-first eyewear.

item.title: The Android Intelligence System: AppFunctions, Remote MCP or Computer Control, and Which One Your App Needs
item.description: Three ways system agents like Gemini can act in your app: AppFunctions (Android MCP), a remote MCP server and OEM Computer Control. What each demands, when to pick which, plus on-device agents with ML Kit and Gemini Nano 4.

item.title: AppFunctions 1.0.0-rc01: Every Breaking Change Since alpha10, and How to Migrate
item.description: AppFunctions hit release candidate on Nov 4, 2026. What changed since alpha10: AppFunctionDeclaration rename, AppFunctionContext removal, explicit isDescribedByKDoc, AppFunctionState, patternMatchers and the rc01 Gradle setup.

item.title: Google Play Subscriptions Next Era: Multi-Quantity, Usage-Based Billing, Mixed Carts and Dynamic Grace Period
item.description: Play's subscription roadmap sorted by availability: multi-quantity seats, usage-based billing, mixed carts, bundles, dynamic grace period, retention and winback offers, plus a verified showInAppMessages sample.

item.title: Android Dev Summit 2026 Keynote: BYO Agent, Android CLI Plugins, AppFunctions Beta and Googlebook
item.description: Which Dev Summit announcements are stable, beta or alpha: Android CLI plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, AppFunctions beta, A2UI, ML Kit Agentic API, Navigation 3 1.2 and Googlebook adaptive guidance.

item.title: Instagram Direct’s AI-Native Compose Migration: 50% Less UI Code and 33% Fewer Tokens
item.description: Meta and Google on migrating Instagram Direct to Compose for AI agents: constructor-only items, a RecyclerView/LazyColumn interop layer, Pausable composition plus LazyLayoutCacheWindow, and 33% lower token cost.

item.title: AppState Alpha: Compose State in Your ViewModels with Transform and StateStore
item.description: AppState 1.0.0-alpha01 takes Compose State out of the UI: transform and listener run composable blocks without UI, StateStore shares keyed state across components, and DataStore sync survives process death.

item.title: Android Dev Summit 2026: LeakCanary in the CLI, R8 Analysis, Recomposition Tracing and Lightbuild
item.description: The Dev Summit tools post, performance half: android profiler leakcanary, android analyze and the R8 Configuration Analyzer, Tracing 2.0, recomposition tracing, Crashlytics heap dumps and the experimental Lightbuild YAML build.

item.title: Jetpack XR SDK 1.0.0 Is Stable: ARCore and SceneCore GA, What Moves in 1.1 Alpha
item.description: ARCore and SceneCore hit 1.0.0 stable on Oct 21. XR Compose is still beta02 with a SceneCore leak workaround, and 1.1.0-alpha01 adds SpatialAnnotation, dynamic meshes and simpler glTF animation.

item.title: Android Studio Rabbit 2: Bring Your Own Agent via ACP, Plus AI Change Review
item.description: Rabbit 2 makes Bring Your Own Agent stable: 40+ ACP agents including Claude Agent and Codex, a Skills Manager and a /review walkthrough for agent changes. Setup, what agents can access and the CLI plugins.

item.title: A2UI for Jetpack Compose: Let AI Agents Render Native UI From Your Component Catalog
item.description: AndroidX now ships an official Compose renderer for the A2UI protocol. The agent describes the UI in JSON, your catalog decides what can render. A2uiSurface, custom components, two-way bindings and what changed in alpha02.

item.title: Compose 1.13 Beta: PolygonShape Rewrite, Required Slider onValueChange and a Faster Modifier.border
item.description: Beta01 and beta02 of Compose 1.13 break PolygonShape, Slider, Modifier.blur and MediaQuery posture APIs, require Kotlin 2.2, and ship a new Modifier.border with opt-out flags. What to fix before stable.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Android: Self-Healing Builds, AGSL Shaders and the android-cli-plugin
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon arrives for Android developers through Antigravity, Android Studio Canary and Firebase AI Logic. Self-healing build loops, AGSL shaders in Compose, android-cli-plugin setup, and who actually has access.
